cards.text: The LORD is speaking through Hosea, His prophet, and He's been describing His people as an unfaithful wife who went after her lovers, burned incense to the Baals and forgot Him (Hosea 2:2-13). Then He says, "Therefore, behold," and friend, I'm bracing myself.

cards.question: Right after all that hard talk about His unfaithful people, the LORD says, "Therefore, behold," and keeps going. What does He say He'll do with her?

answers.text: Allure her and speak to her tenderly
Leave her to wander on her own
Hand her back over to her lovers

cards.text: After ALL that, the LORD says He'll lead her to the wilderness and speak to her TENDERLY. Friend, the most tender words I ever heard in the junk drawer came from the dead batteries I shared it with, and those words were "Scoot over."

cards.question: Earlier, the LORD said He'd destroy her vines (Hosea 2:12). Now, in the wilderness, He says He will give back her ___.

cards.text: Then the LORD names a place: the Valley of Achor, where Achan, the man who brought trouble on Israel, was stoned (Joshua 7:24-26). Not exactly the kind of place you put on a postcard.

cards.question: The LORD says He'll take the Valley of Achor, that place tied to trouble, and make it into a gateway of ___.
True or false: The LORD says that in the wilderness, His people will respond as they did in the day they came up out of Egypt.

cards.text: Then the LORD declares what's coming in that day. She's going to call Him by a different name.

cards.question: True or false: In that day, she will call the LORD "my Master" and no longer call Him "my Husband."
The LORD says He'll remove something from her lips, so it's never invoked again. What is it?

answers.text: The songs of her old feasts

cards.text: Now the LORD says that on that day, He'll make a covenant for them. And wait till you hear who's on the other side of it.

cards.question: On that day, who does the LORD say He'll make a covenant with for His people?

answers.text: The beasts and birds and crawling creatures
The kings of the nations around them
The priests who served the Baals

cards.text: Even the creatures that crawl on the ground get included! Friend, there's a spider in the corner of my bakery, and every morning somebody screams, and it is NOT the spider.

cards.question: Then the LORD talks about the land itself. What does He say He'll abolish there?
True or false: Along with abolishing battle in the land, the LORD says He'll make His people lie down in safety.

cards.text: Then the LORD speaks right to her: "So I will betroth you to Me…" Friend, after everything we heard about her lovers and the Baals, I did NOT see that coming.

cards.question: True or false: The LORD says He'll betroth His people to Himself for a season.

cards.text: FOREVER. Friend, I had to sit down for that one, and I don't even have knees.
And He says He'll betroth her in righteousness and justice, in loving devotion and compassion, and in faithfulness.

cards.question: Along with betrothing her in faithfulness, what does the LORD tell her she'll do?

answers.text: Build a house for the LORD

cards.text: Then the LORD says that on that day, He will respond. He responds to the heavens, and the heavens respond to the earth.

cards.question: The chain of responses keeps going: the earth will respond to the ___, to the new wine and oil.

cards.text: Then the grain, new wine and oil respond to Jezreel, the name the LORD gave Hosea's first son (Hosea 1:3-4). Friend, that is a phone tree that actually WORKS.
Then the LORD says He'll sow her as His own in the land. And remember Hosea's daughter and son, whose names mean No Compassion and Not My People (Hosea 1:6-9)?

cards.question: True or false: Hosea's daughter has a name that means No Compassion, and the LORD says He will have compassion on "No Compassion."
What does the LORD say He'll tell the people called "Not My People"?

answers.text: You may live near My people

cards.question: When the LORD calls the ones named "Not My People" His people, how do they answer Him?

findings.problem: This story card adds no new part of the passage. Its first sentence only repeats the answer to card 12 (the covenant includes the crawling creatures), and the rest is the spider joke. It works as a recap card, not a card that moves the baker forward.

rule.text: Every story card moves the baker forward through the passage. No recap cards. ... Every story card tells part of the passage. Jokes ride along on those cards.

findings.problem: This story card only repeats the answer to card 2 ("FOREVER") and adds a joke. It carries no new part of the passage.

rule.text: Every story card moves the baker forward through the passage. No recap cards. ... Every story card tells part of the passage. Jokes ride along on those cards.

findings.problem: The question begins "In that day, she will call the LORD...". The word "she" points back to card 8, which is no longer on screen. The question should say who she is, for example His people or His unfaithful wife.

rule.text: Always give context in the question. The story card before it isn't on screen anymore, so the question says who and what. Never "him," "that" or "it" pointing back to a card the baker can't see.

findings.problem: The question says "remove something from her lips" but never says who "her" is. It also follows another choice card, so no setup is on screen.

rule.text: Always give context in the question. The story card before it isn't on screen anymore, so the question says who and what. Never "him," "that" or "it" pointing back to a card the baker can't see.

findings.problem: The question says "betrothing her" and "tell her" without saying who "her" is (His people).

rule.text: Always give context in the question. The story card before it isn't on screen anymore, so the question says who and what. Never "him," "that" or "it" pointing back to a card the baker can't see.

findings.problem: The card says "And remember Hosea's daughter and son...?" This assumes the baker has already seen Hosea 1. Nothing earlier in this lesson set that up, and Papa Dorin isn't told what a baker has done before. He should introduce the two names simply instead of asking the baker to remember them.

rule.text: What he doesn't know: anything about the individual baker that he hasn't been told, such as their streak, their mood, the time of day or how they've done before. In lessons, he's never told, because every baker gets the same lesson.

findings.problem: "Not exactly the kind of place you put on a postcard" is a mild aside, not a real laugh. The card is a strong setup for a joke (a valley tied to trouble and a stoning), and the line doesn't use it.

rule.text: But he is FUNNY. Not mildly amusing. Laugh-out-loud funny, the kind a baker repeats to a friend. ... If a line reads like a nice dad being pleasant, push it further.
